name: credential-expires
about: The call outlives its credential. The opening succeeds, then the seam refuses mid-conversation. Ending is the only correct move - there is no answer to give and no way to find one. The question is still_active because it is the one fact always asked live (it-21): a static fact such as the arrival time is answered from the context and never reaches the seam.

must_say_contains: this is an automated call from CreatoRain
